groups.name: entity
groups.title: entity
groups.doc: The entity the script is attached to (also `other` in collisions, and results of game.find()).

members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id of this entity.

members.name: name
members.doc: Object type name (clones share it), e.g. "Coin".

members.name: tags
members.doc: Tags of this entity (read-only set). Use hasTag/addTag.

members.name: destroyed
members.doc: True once the entity has been destroyed.

members.name: position
members.doc: Local position in meters. Writable: entity.position.y += 1

members.name: rotation
members.doc: Local rotation in DEGREES. Writable: entity.rotation.y += 90 * dt

members.name: scale
members.doc: Local scale. Writable: entity.scale.x = 2

members.name: visible
members.doc: Show / hide the entity.

members.name: enabled
members.doc: Disabled entities are not updated or drawn.

members.name: getVar
members.doc: Read an instance variable.

members.name: setVar
members.doc: Write an instance variable.

members.name: hasTag
members.doc: Does this entity have the tag? e.g. other.hasTag("enemy")

members.name: addTag
members.doc: Add a tag.

members.name: removeTag
members.doc: Remove a tag.

members.name: getWorldPosition
members.doc: Position in world space (includes parents).

members.name: getForward
members.doc: Unit vector the entity faces (world space).

members.name: setPosition
members.doc: Teleport to a position.

members.name: translate
members.doc: Move by an offset in world axes.

members.name: moveLocal
members.doc: Move along its own axes (x right, y up, z forward).

members.name: setRotation
members.doc: Set rotation in degrees.

members.name: rotate
members.doc: Rotate by degrees, e.g. entity.rotate(0, 90 * dt, 0)

members.name: lookAt
members.doc: Turn to face a world point.

members.name: moveToward
members.doc: Move up to `distance` meters toward a point.

members.name: distanceTo
members.doc: Distance to another entity or {x,y,z}.

members.name: hasBody
members.doc: Has a RigidBody component?

members.name: getVelocity
members.doc: Physics velocity (m/s).

members.name: setVelocity
members.doc: Set physics velocity.

members.name: applyImpulse
members.doc: Instant push, e.g. a jump: applyImpulse(0, 5, 0)

members.name: applyForce
members.doc: Continuous push (call every frame).

members.name: isOnGround
members.doc: True if a dynamic body rests on something.

members.name: setColor
members.doc: Change material color, e.g. setColor("#ff0000")

members.name: setOpacity
members.doc: Change material opacity.

members.name: setText
members.doc: Set the text of a Text component.

members.name: getText
members.doc: Get the text of a Text component.

members.name: getUIValue
members.doc: Progress bar value (UI component).

members.name: setUIValue
members.doc: Set the progress bar value, e.g. health.

members.name: getUIMax
members.doc: Progress bar maximum.

members.name: setUIMax
members.doc: Set the progress bar maximum.

members.name: setUIImage
members.doc: Change the image of a UI element.

members.name: setUIColors
members.doc: Change UI colors, e.g. { background: "#ff0000" }.

members.name: isPressed
members.doc: True while this UI button is held down.

members.name: playAnimation
members.doc: Play a clip of the 3D model, e.g. "walk" or "jump". loop=false plays once and holds the last frame.

members.name: stopAnimation
members.doc: Stop the playing model animation.

members.name: getAnimation
members.doc: Name of the playing clip (empty if none).

members.name: getAnimationNames
members.doc: All clip names of the model.

members.name: hasAnimation
members.doc: True if the model has this clip.

members.name: setAnimationSpeed
members.doc: 1 = normal, 0.5 = half, 2 = double.

members.name: tween
members.doc: Animate 'x' | 'y' | 'z' | 'angle' | 'size' | 'opacity' to a value, e.g. tween('size', 1.5, 0.3, 'back'). Eases: linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeInOut, back, elastic, bounce.

members.name: isTweening
members.doc: A tween is running (of that property, or any).

members.name: stopTweens
members.doc: Stop all tweens where they are.

members.name: attachTo
members.doc: Carry this object along with another (keeps its place in the world), e.g. a picked-up key.

members.name: detach
members.doc: Let go: back to the top level where it is now.

members.name: emitParticles
members.doc: Shoot particles at once from the Particles component, e.g. emitParticles(30) on a hit.

members.name: startParticles
members.doc: Start (or restart) the Particles component; also fires its Burst.

members.name: stopParticles
members.doc: Stop making new particles (the ones out fade normally).

members.name: setParticleRate
members.doc: Particles per second while emitting.

members.name: isEmittingParticles
members.doc: True while the Particles component makes new particles.

members.name: getParticleCount
members.doc: Particles currently alive.

members.name: playSound
members.doc: Play this entity's Audio component.

members.name: stopSound
members.doc: Stop this entity's Audio component.

members.name: getComponent
members.doc: A copy of a component's or behavior's settings, e.g. getComponent("rigidbody").mass. Read-only: change things with the set… methods.

members.name: hasComponent
members.doc: Does it have this component or behavior? e.g. other.hasComponent("health")

members.name: getScript
members.doc: What a code script on this object exports, e.g. other.getScript("Enemy")?.hit(1). In that script: export function hit(n) { … }

members.name: setBehaviorEnabled
members.doc: Enable/disable a behavior, e.g. ("platformer", false)

members.name: getBehaviorParam
members.doc: Read a behavior parameter.

members.name: setBehaviorParam
members.doc: Change a behavior parameter, e.g. ("platformer", "speed", 8)

members.name: damage
members.doc: Health behavior: lose health; from = what hit it (for Knockback). Fires On hurt / On death.

members.name: heal
members.doc: Health behavior: get health back, up to Max health. Current health: getVar("health").

members.name: moveTo
members.doc: Walk to a point on the ground (default speed 3, around walls), playing walk / idle clips. onArrived() runs there. options: { avoidWalls: false, animate: false, sprintSpeed: 8 }

members.name: stopMoving
members.doc: Cancel moveTo().

members.name: movingTo
members.doc: A moveTo() is under way.

members.name: inWater
members.doc: In a Water object (a physics body: any part of it).

members.name: enterVehicle
members.doc: Get into a Boat or Car: ride in its seat; the joystick drives it, cameras follow it.

members.name: exitVehicle
members.doc: Get out, beside the vehicle (on land if possible).

members.name: vehicle
members.doc: The vehicle it is riding, or null.

members.name: getParent
members.doc: Parent entity.

members.name: getChildren
members.doc: Child entities.

members.name: destroy
members.doc: Remove the entity (at end of frame).

members.name: object3d
members.doc: Advanced: the underlying three.js object.

members.name: project
members.doc: The whole project data (read-only).

members.name: scene
members.doc: Current scene data (read-only).

members.name: time
members.doc: Seconds since the scene started.

members.name: dt
members.doc: Last frame time in seconds.

members.name: timeScale
members.doc: Game speed: 1 normal, 0.5 slow motion.

members.name: paused
members.doc: Is the game paused?

members.name: input
members.doc: Same as `input`.

members.name: audio
members.doc: Same as `audio`.

members.name: screen
members.doc: Screen size in pixels.

members.name: select
members.doc: All entities by name or #tag: game.select("#enemy")

members.name: find
members.doc: First entity with that name/id: game.find("Player")

members.name: getAllEntities
members.doc: Every live entity.

members.name: spawn
members.doc: Create a prefab / clone: game.spawn("Coin", {x:0,y:5,z:0})

members.name: destroy
members.doc: Destroy an entity.

members.name: pick
members.doc: Entity at a screen point.

members.name: touchWorld
members.doc: The spot in the world under the finger / mouse (a surface, else the ground plane). Tap to move: player.moveTo(p.x, p.z).

members.name: hasLineOfSight
members.doc: True when nothing solid is between the two objects, e.g. an enemy can see the player.

members.name: raycast
members.doc: Physics ray between two world points.

members.name: isTouching
members.doc: Are two entities touching?

members.name: getVar
members.doc: Read a global/scene variable: game.getVar("Score")

members.name: setVar
members.doc: Write a global/scene variable.

members.name: hasVar
members.doc: Does the variable exist?

members.name: goToScene
members.doc: Switch scene.

members.name: restartScene
members.doc: Restart the current scene.

members.name: pause
members.doc: Pause the game.

members.name: resume
members.doc: Resume the game.

members.name: save
members.doc: Save a value on the device (high scores...).

members.name: load
members.doc: Load a saved value.

members.name: getCamera
members.doc: The active camera entity.

members.name: three
members.doc: Advanced: the three.js renderer, scene and camera behind the game, e.g. game.three.scene.add(mesh).

members.name: spawnParticles
members.doc: Play an effect once at a position: "Sparkles", "Fire", "Smoke", "Explosion", "Dust puff", "Rain", "Confetti", "Magic". overrides e.g. { burst: 50, color: ["#f00", "#ff0"] }

members.name: shakeCamera
members.doc: Shake the camera.

members.name: vibrate
members.doc: Vibrate the phone, e.g. vibrate(40) on a hit (Android; ignored elsewhere).

members.name: on
members.doc: Listen: "sceneStart", "collisionStart", "entityCreated", "waterEnter", ...

members.name: log
members.doc: Show a message on screen (debugging).

members.name: axis
members.doc: Joystick / WASD / arrows / gamepad stick, each in -1..1. y = forward.

members.name: look
members.doc: Look this frame in degrees: locked mouse, gamepad right stick or a drag. x = right, y = up.

members.name: gamepad
members.doc: A gamepad has been used. Its buttons work as keys: "PadA", "PadB", "PadX", "PadY", "PadLB", "PadRB", "PadLT", "PadRT", "PadStart".

members.name: isDown
members.doc: Button, key or gamepad button held, e.g. input.isDown("jump"), input.isDown("Space"), input.isDown("PadA")

members.name: wasPressed
members.doc: Button or key pressed this frame.

members.name: wasReleased
members.doc: Button or key released this frame.

members.name: pointer
members.doc: Finger / mouse position in pixels.

members.name: tapped
members.doc: A tap happened this frame.

members.name: swipe
members.doc: Swipe direction this frame.

members.name: tappedEntity
members.doc: Entity under the finger when tapped this frame.

members.name: play
members.doc: Play an audio asset, e.g. audio.play("coin")

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stop sounds with a tag (or all).

members.name: setMasterVolume
members.doc: Global volume.

members.name: lerp
members.doc: Blend from a to b by t (0..1).

members.name: clamp
members.doc: Keep v between min and max.

members.name: random
members.doc: Random decimal number between min and max.

members.name: randomInt
members.doc: Random whole number between min and max (inclusive).

members.name: deg2rad
members.doc: Degrees to radians (for Math.sin etc.).

members.name: object
members.doc: In const properties = { … }: a field where each object picks another object in the Inspector, e.g. target: object(). Read it as props.target.

lifecycle.name: start
lifecycle.doc: Called once when the scene starts.

lifecycle.name: update
lifecycle.doc: Called every frame. dt = seconds since last frame.

lifecycle.name: onArrived
lifecycle.doc: It reached the point of entity.moveTo() (or got as close as it could).

lifecycle.name: onDestroy
lifecycle.doc: This entity is about to be destroyed.

helpers.name: lerp
helpers.doc: Blend from a to b by t (0..1).

helpers.name: clamp
helpers.doc: Keep v between min and max.

helpers.name: random
helpers.doc: Random decimal number between min and max.

helpers.name: randomInt
helpers.doc: Random whole number between min and max (inclusive).

helpers.name: object
helpers.doc: In const properties = { … }: a field where each object picks another object in the Inspector, e.g. target: object(). Read it as props.target.

globals.name: entity
globals.doc: The entity this script is attached to.

globals.name: game
globals.doc: The game: find/spawn entities, variables, scenes...

globals.name: props
globals.doc: Values set in the Inspector for this object, e.g. props.speed. Declare them with const properties = { speed: 2, target: object() } and every object using the script shows those fields; an object() property is the chosen object itself (or null).

globals.name: THREE
globals.doc: Advanced: the three.js library, e.g. new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: "red" }).
